card.line: Ephrathah is an old name for Bethlehem in Judah, the town linked to Boaz, Ruth, and King David's family line.

moments.title: A blessing at the gate
moments.text: After Boaz tells the elders and the people that he has acquired Ruth as his wife, they say they are witnesses. They ask the LORD to make him prosperous in Ephrathah and famous in Bethlehem.

moments.title: News of the ark
moments.text: The psalm says, "We heard that the ark was in Ephrathah." The people then found it in the fields of Jaar and called one another to go worship at God's dwelling place.

problems.problem: The second moment says the people heard that the ark was in Ephrathah, but does not clearly place the hearing in Ephrathah.
